solution:
The correct answer is __**2 Ω**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The equivalent resistance between points A and B is **2 Ω**.
 
• To find the equivalent resistance, resistors in series and parallel combinations need to be identified and simplified step-by-step.
 
• Rₛₑᵣᵢₑₛ= R₁ + R₂ = 3 + 3 = 6 Ω
 
• 1/Rₚₐᵣₐₗₗₑₗ = 1/R₁ + 1/R₂ = 1/3 + 1/6 = 3/6 = 1/2
 
• Rparallel = 2 Ω 
 
• In the given circuit, the combination of resistors simplifies to an equivalent resistance of **2 Ω** between points A and B.

• Rseries=R1+R2+…+Rn
